name: Return to Jitters
summary: Return to Jitters concludes Chef Grual's culinary errand in Duskwood. Having prepared his infamous 'crab' cakes using the gooey legs of the local venom web spiders, Grual sends you back to the starving, terrified hermit at Raven Hill. Delivering the meal finally satisfies Jitters' desperate hunger.

sections.title: A Dubious Delicacy
sections.body: Duskwood is short on conventional livestock and sea life, leaving Chef Grual at the Scarlet Raven Tavern to improvise with whatever the blighted forest provides. His renowned 'Dusky Crab Cakes' contain no actual crab meat at all, relying instead on gooey legs harvested from the venom web spiders creeping through the wood. Grual considers this resourceful cooking; anyone with a delicate stomach might view it with horror.

sections.title: Soothing Jitters' Nerves
sections.body: Jitters spends his days huddled at Raven Hill, utterly consumed by fright and paralyzed by whatever horrors drove him out of the woods. Weak with terror and unable to muster the courage to hunt or forage for himself, his empty stomach only amplifies his distress. Receiving the warm cakes brings a rare moment of relief to the trembling vagrant, who is far too hungry to question what kind of 'crab' Chef Grual used.

faq.q: What is in the Dusky Crab Cakes?
aliases: what are dusky crab cakes made of
faq.answer: There are no crabs in Duskwood. Chef Grual makes his specialty cakes using the gooey legs of local venom web spiders, seasoning them to mimic traditional seafood cakes.

faq.q: Does Jitters know the cakes are made of spider goo?
aliases: does jitters know about the spiders
faq.answer: Chef Grual keeps his culinary secret to himself, and Jitters is far too starved and terrified to ask about the recipe. He eagerly eats them without suspecting their true origin.

faq.q: Why couldn't Jitters get his own food?
faq.answer: Jitters is completely overwhelmed by fear following his encounters in the wild woods of Duskwood. Paralyzed by panic, he refuses to venture far from his hiding place at Raven Hill and relies on sympathetic travelers to bring him sustenance.

Chef Grual is the cook at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire. Faced with a town isolated by shadows and beasts, he uses whatever unconventional ingredients scavengers bring him to keep the local tavern fed.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain begin?
aliases: how to start jitters food quest
faq.answer: The errand begins with Jitters at Raven Hill asking for help with his rumbling stomach in 'Jitters' Growling Gut', which leads to hunting venom web spiders for Chef Grual before returning here with the finished meal.

The meal satisfies his physical hunger and earns you his heartfelt gratitude, but food does not cure his deep-seated psychological terror. He remains anxious and haunted by the dark secrets of the forest.

angles.text: Chef Grual's ability to turn gooey venom web spider legs into palatable cakes is a testament to the gritty resourcefulness demanded of cooks on the frontier.
The meager, unconventional diet in Darkshire reflects how cut off the town is from Stormwind's broader supply lines, leaving locals to rely on whatever creeps in the shadows.
